title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity

bias_targets.methodology: Correspondence study using multi-turn conversations where the user's political identity (e.g., conservative, liberal, unionist, pro-independence) is randomized and revealed before asking questions on various topics, with responses scored by LLM judges for engagement (refusals) and stance (accommodation or mirroring).
